messages:
maria_r&D: FYI i'm rolling m-compact-v2 into staging for embed bring-up. early metrics look noisy for short queries and japanese. posting quick numbers + context.

tom_platform: saw a drop on the short-query bench too (recall@1 down ~0.06). index params match prod, but vector norm distribution looks tighter.

hiro_eval: quick stats run:
```
prod m-compact-v1: recall@1=0.74, recall@5=0.88, mean_norm=1.02, silhouette=0.21
staging m-compact-v2: recall@1=0.68, recall@5=0.83, mean_norm=0.78, silhouette=0.13
```
cluster leakage visible on UMAP, especially for es/ja clusters.

anya_ops: reserving staging GPU pool now. enabling sampling logs for vector pipeline for 4h.

kevin_research: config changes for v2: switched to fused-layernorm + aggressive PTQ int4 with per-tensor scaling and a new clamp schedule. suspect either scale mismatch or fold semantics changed geometry.

maria_r&D: agree. can we try: 1) per-channel KL calibration vs current per-tensor minmax 2) disable fused-layernorm folding 3) enforce l2-normalize on output and reindex. which is fastest?

hiro_eval: fastest is L2-normalize + reindex, should be quick (~30m). calibs take longer (~2-3h). i'll kick off the norm run now on the 3k short-query holdout.

tom_platform: small note: index was built with M=24 on staging for throughput testing earlier today; i'm rebuilding M=32 now to match prod. might explain some NN diffs. will report once rebuild done.

hiro_eval: ran L2-normalize + reindex: recall@1 improved from 0.68 -> 0.71, silhouette from 0.13 -> 0.17. still below prod but narrowed gap. attaching 10 example failure pairs in thread.

kevin_research: interesting, normalization helps but doesn't fully recover. next try KL per-channel calibration sweep (auto temp clip + 5 bins). starting now, will run three seeds, comparing recall@1/5/10 and nn-swap-rate. ETA ~2h.

maria_r&D: please include per-lang breakdown and separate short-query vs long-query buckets. prioritize es/ja.

hiro_eval: one quick manual observation: some japanese UI strings map closer to English help docs after quant. maybe embedding space compressed common tokens.

anya_ops: deploy-bot: staging deploy m-compact-v2 started at 2026-03-23T16:12:05Z.

deploy-bot: deploy completed at 2026-03-23T16:15:31Z (sha: c5d6e7f).

kevin_research: calibration sweep results: per-channel KL recovered recall@1 by +0.04 on average; es:+0.06, ja:+0.05, en:+0.02. full numbers: recall@1=0.72, recall@5=0.86, silhouette=0.18. NN-swap-rate down 12%.

hiro_eval: after applying KL per-channel calib and reindex, short-query holdout recall@1 now 0.73 (close to prod). UMAP shows less cluster bleed.

maria_r&D: great! can we add a small regression test to the onboarding pipeline that checks per-lang recall delta and silhouette drop threshold? propose gating: recall@1 delta <= -0.03 and silhouette drop <= -0.05 to pass.

tom_platform: will add a CI check that runs the short-query holdout and multilingual sample as part of the canary job. also locking M/ef_construction in index build to keep parity.

anya_ops: leaving verbose sampling logs for 1h more then revert.

kevin_research: follow-ups: 1) bake per-channel calib into quantization pipeline by default 2) run ablation for fused-layernorm fold and confirm no additional gains 3) document calibration knobs in eval playbook.

maria_r&D: thanks team. if we keep the calib in pipeline and add the CI gate i think we can proceed with a canary. i'll open a PR for the playbook and the gating thresholds.

(ends)
